title: Generalized Quantum Minors Generate Quantized Coordinate Rings
summary: Let $G$ be a simply connected simple complex algebraic group. It is proved by Oya, Qin, and Yakimov that the quantized coordinate ring $\mathcal{O}_q(G)$ is generated by generalized quantum minors, and therefore carries a quantized cluster algebra structure, for all $G$ but type $F_4$. In this article, we settle the $F_4$ case by an argument uniform across $G_2$, $F_4$, and $E_8$.
